pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with jagged, high-angularity edges. The dark patches exhibit a sharp transition to the light network, though pixel gradients are slightly softened by image resolution. Relative spatial area of patches decreases from the neck toward the flank and legs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored negative space. Intersections are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial nodes. Pixel thickness of pathways is non-uniform, appearing wider in the ventral-thoracic region and narrower on the distal limbs.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-scale 1D geometric contour with low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations visible along the mane of the upper neck and shoulder region.
